inputs.name: ElectronEnvironmentAdapter.constructor.config
inputs.description: This required config is retained by the adapter and supplies the Electron host consumed by `connect()`. Its host bridge fields can contain callable members, so the value has no faithful JSON example.

outputs.name: ElectronEnvironmentAdapter.connect
outputs.description: Returns the local Electron environment, passing through `host.harness` as `bridge`. It includes `host.harnessRemote` only when all nine remote-control members are functions; otherwise `host` is undefined.
